detail: MINION young sewer rat: juvenile petite rounded body, softer short fluffy grey-brown fur, slightly oversized rounded ears, wide curious inexperienced amber eyes (not glaring), tiny incisors, tentative cautious low step. No scars/accessories, looks young and naive but still wild rat, not plush mascot.

MINION juvenile collector rat: small plump young rat with soft brown fur and large rounded ears, naive possessive curious eyes, sitting low on haunches with forepaws holding a small scrap of torn cloth and head leaning left. Distinct seated compact silhouette, entire long tail curls beside it. Small incisors, no scars/accessories.

MINION youngest wiry swarm rat: very small thin adolescent rat with shorter sleek pale grey-brown fur, big alert ears and innocent startled eyes, scurrying low forward with front paws outstretched. Simple thin silhouette clearly different from fluffy/seated minions. No scars or ornaments, exactly ONE rat.

VETERAN mature burrow digger: elongated low muscular rat with huge front digging claws, short dusty dark brown fur, small narrowed stern eyes, notched rounded ear, one healed muzzle scar. Front shoulders lowered, one forepaw raised to rake, rear paws planted. No jewelry.

VETERAN hunt flanker: lean long-legged mature rat with narrow waist, sleek charcoal-brown fur, sharp distrustful eyes, one healed eyebrow scar. Sideways circling posture with head looking left, tail extended horizontally low for balance. Body long and agile, no huge fluffy shoulder hump or jewelry.

VETERAN screecher: upright mature rat braced on four paws, head raised left with jaws wide open emitting a shriek, enlarged muscular throat pouch below chin. Severe face, worn dark grey fur, scarred cheek, small ears pinned back. Tall triangular neck/head silhouette, no written effects.

ELITE burrow guardian: broad compact mature grey-brown rat with square strong shoulders, thick neck ruff, a SIMPLE SINGLE BRASS HOOP EARRING in one notched rounded ear. Stubborn narrow eyes, one clean old cheek scar, low braced DEFENSIVE crouch with forepaws close together. No armor/clothes. Distinct wide rectangular compact silhouette.

ELITE Ironfang: lean long-muzzled dark rat with especially LARGE natural ivory incisors and pronounced jaw, one small plain iron ear stud, old nose scar. Head angled left in sideways snarl, long sinewy body and thin tail, sparse shorter fur. Natural teeth not metal. Distinct long narrow silhouette, no armor.

ELITE heavyweight: exceptionally WIDE LOW squat barrel-bodied rat, short thick legs, massive rounded haunches and small neck, brown coarse short fur. Small stern eyes, tiny round ears, one simple ear hoop. Low stable lumbering stance, belly close to ground, heavy but healthy. Distinct oval low silhouette, NOT high shoulder gorilla build.

BOSS brute: tall immense rat with HIGH SHOULDER HUMP and disproportionally POWERFUL FORELEGS, broad forepaws and large claws. Back slopes down to narrower hindquarters, head low with threatening incisors, dark charcoal bristly neck, healed battle scars and small bare ears. Four natural quadruped limbs, forceful forward charging stance. Clearly taller and front-heavy than low round heavyweight; no humanoid fists or jewelry.

BOSS brood leader: tall sinewy experienced alpha rat with lean body, one ear torn and a small plain brass ear ring, narrow intelligent commanding eyes. Standing reared partially on hind legs with one forepaw raised as if directing allies, tail bracing balance; anatomically plausible rat stance. Mature long face and light grey muzzle, shorter neat dark fur. No crown/clothes, exactly one rat.

BOSS RAT KING as a compact LIVING KNOT OF RATS, not one giant rat. About seven individual natural rats clustered into one coherent dense mound, their long bare pink-grey tails woven and tangled together at the center/back. Five clearly readable hostile rat heads looking mostly left, distinct paws and bodies, one larger leading rat atop knot. TWO smaller rats visibly crawling/slipping OUT of the cluster at lower front/side, visually suggesting repeated summoning of fresh rats. Keep readable separated silhouettes and sane anatomy per rat, deliberate negative spaces; not amorphous melted flesh, no extra heads attached to single body. Dark brown-grey illustrated fur, amber eyes and incisors. No crowns, throne, gore, blood, poison, magic cloud or scenery. Whole cluster and two emerging rats fully inside transparent canvas.
